criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Birth Of Trezarlo their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Birth Of Trezarlo as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

arc.premise: Mekhaubest has stopped searching the temple's own archive for a record of the Salthos house's mediator role, and started actually reorganizing the archive itself - shelves rebuilt, patch-records re-filed - so whatever answer does exist won't stay buried by the mess around it.
